title: heliophila maraisiana
intro: Heliophila maraisiana, commonly known as the 'Marais's Heliophila' or 'Bain's Heliophila', is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Heliophila maraisiana include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may be useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
